# Add activity enrollment reports and exports

## Problem

Staff currently have no consolidated way to review participation, capacity, and waitlist levels across activities.

## Proposed outcome

Provide authorized staff with an overview of activity enrollment and capacity, plus downloadable reports for administrative use.

## Acceptance criteria

- Staff can review enrolled count, capacity, and waitlist count by activity and group where applicable.
- Reports can be filtered by relevant activity/group and enrollment status.
- Exported data is clearly labeled and matches the selected report filters.
- The export format is documented and opens in common spreadsheet software.
- Only authorized staff can access student-level reporting.
- The report uses persisted records and does not expose data the viewer is not permitted to see.
